## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Files: `FILE_DOCUMENT` (owner, category, content hash, storage provider and reference, visibility, status) and
`FILE_CATEGORY` (per-tenant limits, `allowPublic`); the `StorageProvider` SPI with `DB`, `LOCAL` and `S3`
shipped (`erp.core.files.storage`); public files at stable URLs under a random slug; single-use download tokens
(`DownloadTokenStore`, in-memory or Redis); since 1.3.0 the image store (type detected from the bytes, SVG
allow-listed) and the private store of server-generated files, optionally restricted to an authority.
Storage paths start with the tenant id.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Whenever bytes exist: a user upload (through the FILE endpoints, a category per use), a generated PDF or
export (`FilePrivateStoreApi`), a logo or photo (`FileImageStoreApi`). The module keeps the `FILE_DOCUMENT.ID`
in a `BIGINT` column (soft read, no FK) and asks `FileDocumentLookupApi` for availability and public URLs.
A new backend (another object store) is a `StorageProvider` bean plus a core migration widening
`CHK_FILE_DOCUMENT_STORAGE_PROVIDER` — proposed to core, not patched.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// a generated statement, stored privately and handed out with a single-use token
StoredPrivateFile stored = filePrivateStoreApi.storePrivateFile(new PrivateFileStoreRequest(
    "SHOP_ORDER", order.getId(), "SHOP", "statement.pdf", "application/pdf", tempPdfPath, null));
DownloadGrant grant = filePrivateStoreApi.issueDownloadToken(stored.documentId());   // GET /api/v1/files/download?token=

// a product photo (PNG/JPEG/WebP only), published at once
ImageStoreResult result = fileImageStoreApi.storePublicImage(new ImageStoreRequest(
    "SHOP_PRODUCT", product.getId(), "SHOP", bytes, "photo", 2_000_000L,
    Set.of(FileImageStoreApi.TYPE_PNG, FileImageStoreApi.TYPE_JPEG, FileImageStoreApi.TYPE_WEBP)));
if (!result.isStored()) throw new LocalizedException(Status.VALIDATION_ERROR, ShopErrorCodes.PHOTO_REJECTED, result.rejection());

// URLs for a page of products, one query
Map<Long, String> urls = fileDocumentLookupApi.publicUrls(photoIds);
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
